drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease with MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 46-year-old male admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.87, creatinine 0.86, hemoglobin 15, platelets 191, sodium 141, wbc 7.3; vitals dbp 68-71, heart_rate 85-89, map 86-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 121-125, spo2 96-97, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.87, hemoglobin 14.9, platelets 197, sodium 141, wbc 7.7; vitals dbp 69-72, heart_rate 85-90, map 87-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 120-125, spo2 96-98, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 46-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Acute hypoxic respiratory failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
